fusions.name: Unstitching Bolt
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt of raw force that deals 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Force Pulse
fusions.desc: A pulse of raw force that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Raised Ward
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs up to 30 damage for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Mana Plating
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
